scripts.phones: npm run assets && PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database "vite --port 4630 --strictPort"
scripts.laptop: npm run assets && PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin:$PATH" LT_HTTP=1 firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database "vite --port 4634 --strictPort"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run assets && PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database "node tests/e2e/run.mjs"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,database,auth --project prod
